notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 24
notes.content:
Fixed languages not working if the Steam client didn't match the chosen language.
Language selection on Steam is now done via the game properties.

[b][url=https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/4984-C127-121D-B3F2]Changing Language[/url][/b]
[olist]
[*]Right click the game title and select [b]Properties...[/b]
[*]Go to the [b]Language[/b] tab.
[*]Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu.
[/olist]
